articles.summary: On November 16, malicious code in Optimizely's A/B testing snippet skimmed cards and swapped crypto wallets on 178 organizations' sites. Why defenses missed it, and six checks to run now.
articles.title: Don’t unknowingly “optimize” your site for third-party supply chain attacks

articles.summary: A hijacked DebugBear script drained $2.7M from Polymarket users in an hour. What retailers should check in their web scripts and mobile app SDKs before Black Friday.
articles.title: Lessons from the Polymarket breach: why the third-party code you trust is the biggest risk to your website and mobile app this holiday season
